legend: B/T mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia with t(11;19)(p15;p13)/NUP98::MLLT1 fusion. Immunophenotype of blasts (red) by flow cytometry: blasts express cCD3, CD19, and CD22 with an intensity approaching that of normal mature T cells (green) and B cells (blue); additionally, blasts express CD7, KIT (CD117), and TdT but lack surface CD3 and cytoplasmic myeloperoxidase.

T/megakaryocytic mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia with CBFA2T3::GLIS2 fusion. There is a dimorphic population of blasts with megakaryoblast and lymphoblast features. Immunophenotype of blasts (red) by flow cytometry: blasts express CD34 (partial), CD41, CD42b, KIT (CD117), CD56, and cCD3 (with an intensity approaching that of normal mature T cells [blue, a part of the lymphocyte population]), and they lack CD45 and HLA-DR.

T/megakaryocytic mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia with CBFA2T3::GLIS3 fusion. There is a dimorphic population of blasts with megakaryoblast and lymphoblast features. Immunophenotype of blasts (red) by flow cytometry: blasts express CD34, CD41 (partial), CD42b (partial), CD45 (dim), and cCD3 (with an intensity approaching that of normal mature T cells [green, a part of the lymphocyte population]).
